content.prompt: An arithmetic sequence has first term $a$ and common difference $d$. Complete the following to find its $n$th term formula:

answer.worked:
Each new term adds one common difference $d$:
$$\begin{aligned}a_4&=a+3d\\a_5&=a+4d\\a_n&=a+(n-1)d\end{aligned}$$
The $n$th term is obtained by adding $d$ to the first term $n-1$ times.
